children: US regional bank's Q3 adjusted EPS rose yr/yr and beat analyst expectations
Net interest income increased yr/yr, driven by loan growth and higher yields
Company reported strong deposit growth from prior quarter
Company says balance sheet is positioned for a higher interest rate environment
Bridgewater expects mix shift to variable-rate loans to support performance if rates rise
Company expects to sustain profitable growth through client relationship expansion
HIGHER LOAN YIELDS - Net interest margin rose due to loan and securities portfolio growth and repricing at higher yields
LOAN AND INVESTMENT GROWTH - Net interest income increased mainly from loan and investment portfolio growth at higher yields
CORE DEPOSIT GROWTH - Core deposits rose, improving deposit mix and supporting loan growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the banks peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Bridgewater Bancshares Inc is $24.00, about 18.1% above its October 19 closing price of $20.33
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
